AI can only summarise what is in the pile, and your best market might not be in it.

This clip is about the catch. AI can only summarise what is in the pile, and reviews come from people who bought and felt strongly enough to write. People who don't ride in winter because they don't feel safe barely appear, and they might be your best market. So talk to people who aren't buying yet.

When you hand AI the reviews, threads and transcripts, ask for the groups the data doesn't cover too.

The voices on the podcast are AI-generated, and mine is a clone of my own voice.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/what-is-marketing-basics/
clips.text: AI is very good at summarising a pile of reviews or forum threads. But it can only summarise what's in the pile. Reviews come from people who bought something and felt strongly enough to write. So you'll hear a lot from existing buyers of other helmets and very little from people who don't ride in the winter because they don't feel safe. Those people might be your best market, and they're not in the data. That's a good point, and it's exactly why the interviews matter. Some of the most useful people to talk to are the ones who aren't buying yet.
